name: calcium carbonate + dimethicone + magnesium hydroxide
uses: Uses relieves heartburn sour stomach acid indigestion the symptoms referred to as gas upset stomach assiciated with these symptoms
otcwarn: Warnings Ask a doctor before use if you have kidney disease a magnesium-restricted diet Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs. Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms last for more than 2 weeks If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children.
